headline: Both Blocs Below 61 in Israel’s Complete Oct. 29 Count Is a 50% Call
deck: The partial count puts both blocs below 61 seats; the 50% call settles YES only if the complete Oct. 29 count does too.
body: A Reuters graphic sourced to the Israel Government reported 4,875,751 of 5,695,682 votes counted as of 12:38 GMT on Oct. 28. [E8]
Central Elections Committee partial results with 84.5% of ballot boxes counted put Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc at 54 seats and Gadi Eisenkot’s bloc at 49. [E2]
The same update put the Joint List and Ra’am at 17 seats. Sixty-one seats are needed for a Knesset majority. [E3] [E5]

The count is not a fixed allocation: the Central Elections Committee’s results were partial, and the final seat projection could change as more votes are counted. That is the mechanism by which the uncounted ballots could move either bloc across the threshold, although the record gives no basis for assigning those ballots to either bloc. [E5]
As counting opened, AP reported that exit polls showed no clear winner. Since the paper’s Oct. 27 coverage, a partial CEC count has replaced the Channel 13 pre-vote poll. [E1] [E6]
The Central Elections Committee expected complete vote-count results Thursday afternoon, Oct. 29. [E4]

**The desk's reading.** The desk assigns a 50% probability that a complete vote count published by Oct. 29 leaves both Netanyahu’s and Eisenkot’s blocs below 61 seats. The starting point is the neutral 50% prior used in the paper’s Oct. 27 forecast. The partial CEC snapshot establishes that both are below the threshold now, but does not establish how the remaining ballots will change their seat totals, so it does not justify moving that prior. The strongest competing reading is that the remaining count lifts one bloc to 61 or more. [E7]

**The next test.** This call settles YES if a complete vote count is published on Oct. 29 and shows both main blocs below the majority threshold. It settles NO if the published count puts either bloc at that threshold or above, or if no complete count is published that day. [E4] [E5]

confidence.label: Both blocs below 61 in complete Oct. 29 count, otherwise NO
